guidelines.title: Management of the Acute Migraine Headache

Covers diagnostic paracentesis, SBP diagnosis/prophylaxis/treatment, albumin use and hepatorenal syndrome -- the trace audit showed v2 answered these nudges with NHSN and HAP/VAP chunks.
